description: Deploy a managed Agent Pod (ClawPod engine) paid from Cloud credits. Needs a key with the "spend" permission, max_usd and idempotency_key. See tiers and models with cloud_pod_catalog.

computeApiKey.description: Singularity Cloud API key with the "spend" permission (cloud.x402compute.cc > Settings > API keys).

idempotency_key.description: A new unique id per purchase (8 to 128 letters, digits, . _ : -). Repeating a purchase with the SAME id never charges twice.

max_usd.description: The most you agree to pay, in US dollars. Refused before any charge if the price is higher.

model.description: Optional model from the tier list in cloud_pod_catalog

term_hours.description: Prepaid hours, at least 24. 720 is one month and the best price per day. Default 720.

name: cloud_deploy_pod
